content:
We are currently keeping a close eye on several iPhone 18 Pro accessories, planning to pick them up before the Friday order deadline, as we will be using them ourselves this year. If we had to choose, Apple's AirTag 2 and the new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are definitely the best accessories to pair with the iPhone 18 Pro—not to mention that world's greatest Polishing Cloth, which is also well worth buying. However, this time we want to go deeper—we'll cover chargers, MagSafe car mounts, cases, wallets, you name it. Below, we'll introduce them one by one.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance—Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)
  • Ben—Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael—Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin—Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet (with MagSafe)
  • Ryan—MagSafe Car Mount (compatible with iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Fernando—Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra-Slim Magnetic Power Bank
  • Simon—Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Charger
  • Justin—Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette—Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Other Accessories We Genuinely Recommend

If you want to charge your newly purchased iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max at the fastest speed, you'll need a compatible charging adapter. To be specific, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply—and Apple's own offering is the best choice on the market. It's compact enough and foldable, and it can charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case comes in various deep-tone colors and combines a beautiful appearance, a very grippy texture, solid tactile feedback from the anodized aluminum buttons, and is made entirely from 100% recycled polyester yarn, making it environmentally friendly.

Anker's compact 3-in-1 wireless charger can simultaneously charge three devices through a single portable accessory, with the iPhone position supporting Qi2 wireless charging, compatible with MagSafe. When folded, it's small enough to easily fit into a travel bag—meaning you no longer have to lug around a bunch of cables and adapters to the hotel—or you can place it on your nightstand or desk, neatly organizing your entire Apple ecosystem. It's currently on sale on Amazon at nearly 35% off, an all-time low.

Apple's FineWoven Wallet (with MagSafe) has always been a must-have accessory for Apple fans who prefer a minimalist style. It easily fits 3 to 4 cards—whether it's an ID, a few credit cards, or a hotel key card—perfect for those who don't want to carry a bulky wallet around.

Whenever I'm driving, I always want to find a stable and safe place to put my phone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top choice. You can securely magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or older models to the mount, and it's also very convenient to clip directly onto the air vent. This MagSafe car mount not only protects your iPhone well but also keeps the screen clearly visible, and you can charge while driving without any issues.

I've always believed that for a MagSafe magnetic power bank to truly be practical enough to carry around with your iPhone on a daily basis, it needs to be thin. Baseus has just launched what I consider to be a nearly perfect magnetic power bank. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It has a built-in 5,000mAh battery, supports 7.5W wireless charging and 22.5W wired input. The best part is that it's available in a new Burgundy color to match the new iPhone—now that's what an ultra-thin magnetic power bank should look like.

If you're constantly on the go, you'll understand that being able to keep your tech bag neatly organized is already half the battle. That's why I always keep an eye out for versatile charging solutions. Baseus's travel charger fits the bill perfectly—it supports plugs from over 200 countries and is designed to charge six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest highlight is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can fast-charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while also stably delivering power to your iPad, MacBook, and other devices.

Earlier, Michael picked what I consider the best travel-friendly foldable MagSafe charger, but this time I want to focus on my two favorite desktop 3-in-1 models: the stunningly beautiful and clean-looking Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand in a gorgeous Space Black; and the Anker Smart Display 3-in-1, which I also really like—but the Satechi is simply so elegant and refined, there's no contest.

After spending a fortune on the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually opt for more affordable accessories, not splurging on the most expensive ones. Spigen has plenty of budget-friendly MagSafe cases. My personal top pick is this transparent Ultra Hybrid MagFit case, priced far lower than other brands—there are also opaque multi-color options available, all supporting fast MagSafe wireless charging. The TPU sides of these cases are infused with DuraClear blue resin to prevent yellowing, and feature shock-absorbing designs; notably, the Camera Control button surface is also wrapped in a thin layer of TPU.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • New Pitaka Burgundy Aramid Fiber iPhone 18 Pro Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracker Card
